target_fidelity.note: It is a positive active imperative with no modal.

grammaticality.note: “Turn on the light.” is grammatical English.

naturalness.note: The dark-room context makes the instruction coherent and natural.

pedagogical_suitability.note: It provides focused practice producing an imperative.

determinacy.note: “Turn the light on” is an equally natural response but is not accepted.

non_target_language_simplicity.note: The vocabulary and situation are very common and transparent.

no_answer_leakage.note: The prompt gives a cue, not the completed target sentence.

no_extraneous_grammar.note: No unrelated or advanced grammar is needed.

no_world_knowledge.note: The item requires no external factual or specialist knowledge.
